2610.13253.title: Tabular Foundation Models Are Effectively Shallow
2610.13253.paper_summary: In-context-learning Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) are uniquely suited to scenarios with limited resources or privacy constraints, as they solve new tasks without additional training. However, their architecture consists of multiple transformer blocks, resulting in high computational and memory footprints. Meanwhile, traditional alternatives like Gradient-Boosted Decision Trees (GBDTs) remain highly competitive and run efficiently on CPUs, suggesting that tabular tasks may not inherently require deep architectures. This contrast raises a fundamental question: can TFMs be simplified by removing architectural redundancies without sacrificing performance? To answer this, we introduce a closed-form, label-free affine translator that replaces a contiguous window of up to 96% of the blocks, leaving the rest unchanged. Evaluating eight frontier TFMs on 171 classification datasets, we reveal that tabular transformers are vastly overparameterized: replacing half of a model's blocks costs at most $0.002$ median AUROC across all architectures, with the half-depth TabFM still outperforming every other full-depth TFMs and tuned GBDTs. Furthermore, different model families are overparameterized in different ways: TabPFN-3 relies on its encoders, maintaining performance regardless of which single block is retained. Other single-axis models spread computation thinly, needing only their first block, while dual-axis models concentrate it in one critical block. Ultimately, removing depth saves up to 1.5B parameters, speeds up GPU inference by up to $6\times$ at a median cost of $0.03$ AUROC, while a single-block TabPFN-3 serves cached queries $2.4\times$ faster using $6\times$ less memory at negligible cost.
2610.13253.paper_summary_zh: 在上下文學習的表格基礎模型（TFMs）特別適合資源有限或隱私受限的情境，因為它們可以在不進行額外訓練的情況下解決新任務。<lb/>然而，它們的架構由多個Transformer區塊組成，導致高計算和記憶體需求。<lb/>同時，傳統的替代方案如梯度增強決策樹（GBDTs）仍然具有高度競爭力，並能在CPU上高效運行，這表明表格任務本質上可能不需要深度架構。<lb/>這種對比引發了一個基本問題：能否通過去除架構冗餘來簡化TFMs，而不犧牲性能？<lb/>為了解答這個問題，我們介紹了一種封閉形式的無標籤仿射轉換器，它可以替換多達96%的連續區塊，其他部分保持不變。<lb/>對171個分類數據集上進行八個前沿TFMs的評估，我們發現表格Transformer的參數過多：替換模型一半的區塊在所有架構中最多只會損失$0.002$的中位數AUROC，而半深度的TabFM仍然優於其他所有全深度TFMs和調整過的GBDTs。<lb/>此外，不同的模型家族以不同的方式過度參數化：TabPFN-3依賴於其編碼器，無論保留哪個單一區塊都能維持性能。<lb/>其他單軸模型則薄弱地分散計算，只需要它們的第一個區塊，而雙軸模型則將計算集中在一個關鍵區塊上。<lb/>最終，去除深度可節省多達15億個參數，並在中位數成本$0.03$ AUROC的情況下，將GPU推理速度提高至最多$6\times$，而單區塊的TabPFN-3在使用$6\times$更少的記憶體的情況下，能以$2.4\times$的速度服務快取查詢，成本可忽略不計。
